notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 0.2.1 and World 2 & 3 release schedule
notes.content:
[h1]Hello to everyone![/h1]

After we received feedback, we have made some changes to the game, and it's systems for you to play better, faster, and smoother (The changes list will be at the bottom)

This Friday [b][u](Feb 8th)[/u][/b] we will release the second world, which will include five more themed levels, new enemies, new challenges, and new power.

[u][b]Feb 22nd[/b][/u] we plan on releasing the third world as well, so stay tuned for more information about that in our social accounts.
Twitter: [b]@evgeny_gutman[/b]
Instagram: [b]@bulletbears[/b]

Thank you for your time and feedback!


List of changes:
[list]
[*]Changed: the Camera system
[*]Changed: Player movement system
[*]Added: Bonus teleports at levels 2 & 4
[*]Added: Resolution refresh rate in the settings
[*]Added: Text above checkpoints and Finish flowers
[*]Fixed: Resolution duplicates showing
[*]Fixed: Some lighting cause extreme frame drops
[*]Fixed: Level 2 inside the tree is see through
[*]Fixed: Opening cutscene volume
[/list]

If you have and questions or feedback regarding the game, go to the [b]community tab[/b] and post your thoughts!

notes.title: Early Access, Here we come!
notes.content:
Hello to all of our group members!
In the [u][b]1st of February[/b][/u] we will launch our game as an Early Access title!

Platformer as Early Access? [b]Why and How?[/b]

[u][h1]Firstly, Why?[/h1][/u]
Well, We spoke about this option in a meeting and we thought that instead of releasing a full game in the date mentioned above, it would not help the game to develop as we wish it could.
So, we thought about the option to release it as an Early Access title to gain more feedback while we continue to develop the game itself!
This way we can add your ideas and feedback to the game while it continues to develop.

As you all know, being an Indie studio is tough.
It comes with a lot of financial difficulties and time consumption as well.
So the plan is to get support while we improve the game with you!

[u][h1]Secondly, How?[/h1][/u]
Well, our idea as for Early Access is to release the first world to the public to tinker and play with while we work on the next world.
That way, when we will finish working on the next world and update the game, we will start gathering all the feedback from you guys!
That means the next world update will come with fixes, feedback changes and new features for the previous worlds.

I hope you will join us in this fantastic adventure!
